verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of a feature that exports all of a user's data in open formats for leaving Figma. The REST API's ability to 'view and extract any objects or layers' is a developer building block, not an account-wide export capability. Community reports describe single-asset SVG copying and say full-fidelity work is 'locked up in a proprietary format,' which reinforces the absence of an open-format bulk export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
